title: Khanjaar Dhi Dhaar Thalay Maan
body:
Khanjaar dhi dhaar thalay maan ambhiyaan vaan dah
<<DIVIDER>>
Kussan dah kauf nahin, fikaar hain riddah vaan dah.
<<DIVIDER>>
–  Khudah deena ch’ denah, laal enjh ko ha ay hun
Sabar Hussain dah ay, honsla imaam vanda.
<<DIVIDER>>
–  Sataar kadaam tay nahin, vendhi kusdah veeran ku
Nah bhain bhayi avay, faisilah bhira vanda.
<<DIVIDER>>
–  Sakina vekh rayee, raha chacha Ghazi dah
Au zheen choor gaya, Shainshah waafah vanda.
<<DIVIDER>>
–  Pathar hataan dhi kaday, labdhi sayn veeran nu
Sajaad takh dah raya, majmah haya vanda.
<<DIVIDER>>
–  Ay zikhaar majlis ay Shabbir, tai zanjeer zaani
Ay pursa ajaar meri, Sayn dhi dua vanda.
